summary: Eleven selected items sit within the 6-11 target. The day's dominant story (U.S. government gating GPT-5.6 access) is covered through three genuinely distinct angles: ns123abc's high-engagement breaking summary, steph_palazzolo's first-party The Information scoop, and AndrewCurran_'s primary Amodei letter to the White House and named senators. No author is overrepresented (each appears once). The Codex/agentic-work thread is anchored by the official OpenAI post, with redundant reserve duplicates (thsottiaux, gdb) correctly left out. The main traceability concern is JonhernandezIA's dramatic Hassabis 'edge of the singularity' paraphrase from a secondary aggregator account with no linked primary; it is flagged but retained since Twitter-only verification cannot resolve it and the engagement and relevance justify inclusion. All eleven decisions are keep; no replacements needed and the reserve pool offers no superior same-angle substitute.
